# Migaku

> Migaku is a comprehensive language learning platform specializing in Japanese, Korean, and Chinese (Mandarin and Cantonese) through immersion-based methods and community support.

Migaku offers detailed grammar guides, vocabulary lessons, cultural insights, and pronunciation tutorials for East Asian languages. The platform emphasizes practical learning through real-world contexts and maintains an active Discord community of 12,000+ learners.

## Key Topics

- Japanese language learning
- Korean language learning
- Mandarin Chinese
- Cantonese
- Kanji, Hiragana, Katakana
- Hangul
- Grammar fundamentals
- Vocabulary building
- Pronunciation and tones
- Language comparison guides
- Immersion-based learning
- Discord community
- Cultural etiquette
- Beginner guides
- Speech levels and formality

## Language Learning Fundamentals

- [Korean Sentence Structure: The Only Guide You Need (2025)](https://migaku.com/blog/korean/korean-sentence-structure): Korean SOV sentence structure: word order, particles, grammar fundamentals
- [Chinese Reading Practice: 4 Stages for Better Reading Skill](https://migaku.com/blog/chinese/chinese-reading-practice): 4-stage Chinese reading method: vocab building, sentence mining, immersion
- [Chinese Tone Pairs: Simple Steps to Learn Common Tone Change](https://migaku.com/blog/chinese/chinese-tone-pairs): Mandarin tone pairs: third tone sandhi, tone change rules, pronunciation
- [Korean Speech Levels: 반말 Guide (When to Use Informal)](https://migaku.com/blog/korean/korean-informal-speech): Korean speech levels: banmal vs jondaetmal, 7 formality levels explained
- [Japanese Particle も: Complete Grammar Guide for Beginners](https://migaku.com/blog/japanese/japanese-particle-mo): Japanese particle も (mo): usage for 'also', 'too', 'even', JLPT N4 guide

## Language Comparison Guides

- [Japanese vs Korean: Which Language Should You Learn?](https://migaku.com/blog/japanese/japanese-vs-korean): Compare Japanese vs Korean: writing systems, grammar, difficulty for learners
- [Mandarin vs Cantonese: Which Chinese Language to Learn?](https://migaku.com/blog/chinese/mandarin-vs-cantonese): Mandarin vs Cantonese comparison: tones, scripts, which to learn first

## Japanese Language Resources

- [How to Say Nice to Meet You in Japanese (Hajimemashite Guide)](https://migaku.com/blog/japanese/nice-to-meet-you-in-japanese): Hajimemashite guide: Japanese greetings for formal/casual introductions
- [7 Essential Ways to Say Thank You in Japanese, From Casual to Formal](https://migaku.com/blog/japanese/thank-you-in-japanese): 7 Japanese thank you phrases: arigatou to formal expressions, etiquette
- [Japanese House Vocabulary: Rooms, Furniture & Home Words](https://migaku.com/blog/japanese/japanese-house-vocabulary): Japanese house vocab guide: rooms, furniture, traditional home elements
- [Japanese Bowing: When and How to Bow Properly in Japan](https://migaku.com/blog/japanese/japanese-bowing): Japanese bowing etiquette: eshaku, keirei, saikeirei types and customs

## Chinese Language Resources

- [Chinese Phrases for Travelers: Greetings, Ordering, and More](https://migaku.com/blog/chinese/chinese-travel-phrases): Essential Mandarin travel phrases: greetings, ordering, transportation vocab
- [Chinese Emotions Vocabulary: How to Express Your Feelings](https://migaku.com/blog/chinese/chinese-emotions-vocabulary): Mandarin emotions vocab: nuanced expressions for positive/negative feelings
- [How to Say Sorry in Cantonese: 對唔住 vs 唔好意思](https://migaku.com/blog/chinese/sorry-in-cantonese): Cantonese apology phrases: pronunciation, usage, Hong Kong cultural context
- [Best Chinese Podcasts for Mandarin Learners in 2026](https://migaku.com/blog/chinese/best-chinese-podcasts-mandarin-learners): Top Mandarin podcasts 2026: beginner to advanced listening practice resources

## Korean Language Resources

- [40+ Korean Slang Words You Must Know (2025 Guide)](https://migaku.com/blog/korean/korean-slang): 40+ Korean slang terms: K-pop vocabulary, texting abbreviations, native speech
